source_text:
Ἰωάννης δὲ ὁ
εὐαγγελικὸς ἀετός, ἡ θεολόγος λύρα, μόνην τὴν ἄναρχον καὶ ἀμάρτυρον γέννησιν
ἐκήρυξεν καὶ τὴν συναΐδιον ὕπαρξιν. Καὶ ἐμφραττέσθω τῶν φιλολοιδόρων τὰ
στόματα, ὅτι μόνος ἐκ μόνου ἐγεννήθη καὶ ἀμάρτυρος ἡ ἄνω γέννησις. Χρόνος μὲν
γὰρ οὐ παρῆν· αὐτὸς γάρ ἐστι πάντων τῶν αἰώνων δημιουργός. Ἄγγελος οὐ παρῆν·
αὐτὸς γάρ ἐστιν «ὁ ποιῶν τοὺς ἀγγέλους αὐτοῦ πνεύματα καὶ τοὺς λειτουργοὺς
αὐτοῦ πῦρ φλέγον.» Οὐρανὸς οὐ παρῆν· «Τῷ γὰρ Λόγῳ κυρίου οἱ οὐρανοὶ
ἐστερεώθησαν.» Ἥλιος οὐ παρῆν· αὐτὸς γὰρ ὑπάρχει «ὁ τῆς δικαιοσύνης ἥλιος».
Σελήνη οὐ παρῆν· «Σελήνην γὰρ καὶ ἀστέρας αὐτὸς ἐθεμελίωσεν.» Γῆ οὐ παρῆν·
αὐτὸς γὰρ εἶπεν· «Συναχθήτω τὰ ὕδατα καὶ ὀφθήτω ἡ ξηρά.» Ἀμάρτυρος οὖν ἡ ἄνω
γέννησις, θεία καὶ ἀπερινόητος, ἐπειδὴ μόνος οἶδεν ὁ Πατὴρ πῶς ἐγέννησεν, καὶ ὁ
Υἱὸς πῶς ἐγεννήθη. Ὁ τοίνυν Ἰωάννης μόνος τὴν ἄναρχον γέννησιν καὶ τὴν
συναΐδιον ὕπαρξιν ἐκήρυξεν.
7 Ὁ δὲ μακάριος Λουκᾶς, ὁ τῶν εὐαγγελιστῶν ἐξαίρετος καὶ τοῦ θαυμαστοῦ
τούτου λίθου καὶ τιμίου μαργαρίτου ἔμπορος, ὁ ἄγρυπνος τῆς πόλεως φύλαξ, ὁ
ἔμπειρος τῶν ψυχῶν ἰατρός, τὸ ἀπόρθητον τῶν βασιλέων τεῖχος, ὅλον ὁμοῦ
διηγήσατο τὸ μυ-στήριον, τοῦ Γαβριὴλ τὰ εὐαγγέλια, τῆς παρθένου τὴν εὐλάβειαν,
τοῦ ἁγίου Πνεύματος τὴν ἐπιφοίτησιν, τὴν τοῦ θεοῦ μορφήν, τὴν ἀπαθῆ κένωσιν τῆς
θεότητος, τὸ ἄτρεπτον τῆς ἐνανθρωπήσεως καὶ ἀσύγχυτον, τῆς παρθενίας τὸ
ἄσυλον, τῆς συλλήψεως τὸ αὐτοσχέδιον, τοῦ τόκου τὸ ἄφθορον, τὸν τοῦ ἀγγέλου
εὐαγγελισμὸν πρὸς τὴν παρθένον εἰπόντος· «Χαῖρε, κεχαριτωμένη, ὁ κύριος μετὰ
σοῦ.»
8 Ὢ ἀσπασμὸς οὐδενὶ ἄλλῳ ἁρμόσας, εἰ μὴ μόνῃ τῇ ἁγίᾳ παρθένῳ. Ἔτεκεν
Εὔα ἀλλ' ἐν λύπαις, ἔτεκε Σάρρα ἀλλ' ἐν πόνῳ, ἔτεκε Ῥεβέκκα ἀλλ' ἐν στεναγμοῖς,
ἔτεκεν Ἅννα ἀλλ' ἐν δάκρυσιν, ἔτεκεν Ἐλισάβετ ἀλλ' ἐν φθορᾷ, πᾶσαι ἐν λύπαις
ἔτεκον ἐπειδὴ πᾶσαι μετὰ φθορᾶς συνέλαβον. Σὺ δὲ μόνη χαῖρε, ἡ πύλη τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ
μυστηρίου νεφέλη. Σὺ μόνη χαῖρε, ὁ ἀστενοχώρητος τοῦ ἀπεριγράπτου ναός. Σὺ
μόνη χαῖρε· ὁ γὰρ ἐκ σοῦ σαρκούμενος «ἀφεῖλε πᾶν δάκρυον ἀπὸ παντὸς
προσώπου».
thought_title: John tells the eternal birth, Luke tells the whole mystery
orientation: Hesychius has set out how Matthew and Mark began, and now contrasts John's proclamation of the eternal generation with Luke's full narration of the incarnation.
pass_a_gloss: But John, the eagle of the gospel, the lyre that speaks of God, proclaimed only the generation without beginning and without witness and the existence together eternal. And let the mouths of those who love insult be shut, because Alone from Alone he was begotten and without witness is the generation above. For time was not present alongside; for he himself is maker of all the ages. Angel was not present alongside; for he himself is the one making his angels spirits and his servants flaming fire. Heaven was not present alongside; for by the Word of the Lord the heavens were made firm. Sun was not present alongside; for he himself is the sun of righteousness. Moon was not present alongside; for moon and stars he himself founded. Earth was not present alongside; for he himself said: Let the waters be gathered together and let the dry land appear. Without witness therefore is the generation above, divine and beyond understanding, because the Father alone knows how he begot, and the Son how he was begotten. Therefore John alone proclaimed the generation without beginning and the existence together eternal. And the blessed Luke, the choice one among the evangelists and trader of this wonderful stone and precious pearl, the sleepless guard of the city, the skilled physician of souls, the unstormed wall of kings, narrated together as a whole the mystery, the good tidings of Gabriel, the reverence of the Virgin Mary, the visitation of the Holy Spirit, the form of God, the emptying of the divinity involving no suffering, the unchangeable and unconfused character of the incarnation, the inviolable character of virginity, the sudden character of the conception, the incorruptible character of the birth, the announcement of the angel when he said to the Virgin Mary: Rejoice, favored one, the Lord is with you. O greeting that fitted no other except the holy Virgin Mary alone. Eve bore but in griefs, Sarah bore but in pain, Rebecca bore but in groanings, Hannah bore but in tears, Elizabeth bore but in corruption, all bore in griefs because all conceived with corruption. But you alone rejoice, the gate of God and cloud of mystery. You alone rejoice, the temple that has no room for the one who cannot be circumscribed. You alone rejoice; for the one being made flesh from you took away every tear from every face.

pass_b_english: John, the eagle among evangelists and lyre that speaks of God, proclaimed only the generation without beginning and without witness, and existence together eternal. Let the mouths of those who love insults be stopped, for the Son alone was begotten from the Father alone, and the generation above is without witness. No time was there, for he himself is the maker of all ages. No angel was there, for he himself is the one “who makes his angels spirits and his ministers a flaming fire” (Psalm 104:4). No heaven was there, for “by the divine Word of the Lord the heavens were made firm” (Psalm 33:6). No sun was there, for he himself is “the sun of righteousness” (Malachi 4:2). No moon was there, for “the moon and the stars he himself founded” (Psalm 8:3). No earth was there, for he himself said, “Let the waters be gathered together and let the dry land appear” (Genesis 1:9). The generation above is therefore without witness, divine and beyond all understanding, since the Father alone knows how he begot and the Son alone knows how he was begotten. So John alone proclaimed the generation without beginning and existence together eternal.

But blessed Luke, the chosen treasure among evangelists and trader in this wondrous stone and precious pearl, the sleepless guard of the city, the skilled physician of souls, and the unbreached wall of kings, told the whole mystery together at once. He told of Gabriel’s good news, the reverence of the Virgin Mary, the visitation of the Holy Spirit, the form of God, the impassible self-emptying of his divinity, the unchanging and unconfused incarnation, the inviolate virginity, the sudden conception, and the incorrupt birth. He told of the angel’s announcement to the Virgin Mary, when he said, “Rejoice, favored one, the Lord is with you” (Luke 1:28).

O greeting that suited no one else except the holy Virgin Mary alone. Eve gave birth, but in sorrows. Sarah gave birth, but in pain. Rebecca gave birth, but in groanings. Hannah gave birth, but in tears. Elizabeth gave birth, but in corruption. They all gave birth in sorrows because they all conceived in corruption. But you alone rejoice, gate of God and cloud of mystery. You alone rejoice, temple that holds the one whom nothing can contain. You alone rejoice, for the one who takes flesh from you “has taken away every tear from every face” (Isaiah 25:8).
notes: line break in source divides μυ-στήριον; read as μυστήριον
moon and stars clause changes person to third singular against the psalm wording; glossed as written
